title: Emrys and the Ghost
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Wren Ravensworth, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
